spans.s: पृत् f. An army.(This word has no forms for the first five cases; according to some, it is an optional substitute for पृतना q.v.).
पृतना f. 1. An army in general; 2. a division of an army consisting of 243 chariots, as many elephants, 729 horse and 1215 foot; 3. fight, encounter.
पृतना-साह् m. an epithet of Indra.
